era: Late-2019 Getty Images (home 2019-11/12, detail 2019-11 and creative-video 2019-11 captures): white header with the hamburger BROWSE and PRICING at left, the centred gettyimages logo, BOARDS, CART and an outlined SIGN IN at right; a #e6e6e6 hero with 'Moving the world with images' in light Lato and a square search field with the 'Creative Images' picker; the CREATIVE / EDITORIAL / VIDEO / MUSIC tabs with a purple underline; purple outlined keyword chips and the purple footer with Solutions / Products / Company / Support columns. The same page for every visitor.
